title: Is an Energy Truce Viable in the Ukraine War?
summary_en: An energy truce in the Ukraine war before winter would serve Kyiv, Moscow, and global markets, yet past pauses have repeatedly broken down. A deal can hold only with a narrow target registry, independent satellite-based verification, and graduated responses to violations.

title: Wrong Place, Right Line: Interregional Transmission as a Hedge Against Uncertain Large Loads
summary_en: Data centers and other large loads are reshaping U.S. electricity demand, but where and when they will materialize remains deeply uncertain. This piece argues interregional transmission offers a resilient hedge against that uncertainty in transmission planning.
